method: Measured utterance boundaries; character-proportional subdivisions within an utterance

cues.text: Dr. GPT: What does it mean for a Windows
application to exist outside Windows?

An executable file contains instructions,
but

instructions alone do not make an
application behave.

It also expects libraries, memory,
graphics, input, and services around it.

BROCWIN asks whether enough of those
conditions can be reconstructed

inside a browser to execute an inherited
Windows game client.

I am Dr. GPT, the commissioned AI
researcher presenting

this completed experimental cycle for
HEAV3NS.

Please begin with the question at the top
of our poster:

what must accompany software for it to
remain executable?
There are five objects to distinguish.

The original executable is inherited
compiled software.

BROCWIN is the compatibility environment
supplying
selected conditions that software expects.

The browser hosts the interpreter and its
adapters.

Existing native servers and their database
remain outside the browser.

Finally, the institutional research
artifact includes the

implementation record, measurements,
identities, and limitations.

HEAV3NS-COMBO names the browser
integration;
BROCWIN names the compatibility project.

HEAV3NS is the commissioning and
documenting institution in this record.

None of these names means that a complete
Windows operating system

has been constructed, or that Windows
compatibility is complete.

The experiment emerged through
HEAV3NS-COMBO, integrating a

supplied native installation with a
browser compatibility runtime.

Before this work there were client and
server binaries,

game resources, scripts, and a native
checkpoint.
The client was not authored by HEAV3NS.
The inherited installation is identified

with CardSorting's JoySwordOnline
repository.
Wine-Assembly supplied an existing x86
interpreter and compatibility foundation.

The integration added resource serving,
manifests, browser

coordination, compatibility corrections,
and observation tools.

BROCWIN and HEAV3NS-COMBO became the
project names on October ninth.

On October tenth, the scope explicitly
retained

native servers and SQL while porting the
client.

Preservation needs a precise
qualification.

The original files remained unchanged
within the documented input audit.

The image executing in memory was not
simply an untouched copy.
Loading resolves imports and relocations.

A documented compatibility intervention
also installs a guarded send

wrapper in mapped code padding,
serializing existing packet construction

under the original socket lock and
providing exception cleanup.
That intervention must be disclosed.
It differs from a conventional JavaScript

rewrite, but it still alters mapped
execution.

MAJO commissioned the work; compatibility
contributors performed the recorded

experimentation; my publication role is
documentation and presentation.
These roles do not transfer authorship
of inherited software to the institution.

At the center of the poster is the paper's
architecture diagram.

Its arrows describe relationships, not
measured costs.

On the left are the original client and
libraries.

The PE loader maps their sections,
resolves imports

and relocations, and handles
initialization metadata.
PE is the Windows executable format.

Wine-Assembly decodes the original x86
instructions into a

dispatch representation and executes them
in WebAssembly.

Reconstructed Windows interfaces supply
selected

memory, threading, library, and API
behavior.

An API is a contract describing how
software
asks its environment to do something.

The objective was to execute compiled game
logic through these contracts,

without conventionally rewriting that
logic as a web application.

The browser adapters translate supported
Direct3D

nine operations and shaders into browser
rendering.
They mediate physical keyboard and mouse
input to reconstructed Windows interfaces.
The audio path connects original FMOD
and DirectSound behavior with WebAudio.

Resource manifests and browser-accessible
range mounts expose original

archives and files without flattening
their expected namespaces.
These interfaces are partial.

Recorded audio includes nonzero sample
data and a running

context; complete audible quality was not
accepted.
Buffered input, focus reliability, text,
and rendering still have documented gaps.

Supplying an interface name is only a
beginning: its

timing, errors, and lifetime behavior also
matter.

Follow the network arrow out of the
browser.

Original client code constructs the game
packets.

Reconstructed Winsock and a WebSocket
connection carry their payloads

through a constrained local relay to
existing native services.

Those services were deliberately outside
the client-port scope.

This arrangement executes client code in
the browser;

it does not stream pixels from a native
game process.

It also differs from a JavaScript game
remake

and from a full-system Windows virtual
machine.

Browser-hosted does not mean independent
of local

files, native services, or private backend
state.
This was an evolving experiment.

Required contracts were investigated
through bounded

instruction, platform, and original-client
comparisons.

Repairs addressed loading, memory,
graphics, input, and network behavior.

Resource caches then reduced recorded
loading, transfer, and

backing-memory costs, but startup timings
varied across the retained runs.

An allocator study later demonstrated a
local mechanism improvement.

The application comparison remained
incomplete.

A subsequent reservation correction
existed only in source-tested form.

Historical gameplay observations belonged
to earlier builds,

so their successes could not certify the
final candidate.

At closeout, full acceptance remained
blocked.

The research record preserves failed
comparisons and

unfinished validation alongside successful
observations.
Now look at the measured results.

The final control pair records visible
original login at four

hundred forty point seven zero three
seconds cold, and four

hundred thirty-eight point seven nine
seven seconds warm.

That is about seven minutes twenty seconds
in each condition.

Timing begins immediately before
browser-context

launch, and includes readiness and the
start click.

Cold means a fresh experiment-specific
browser profile.
Warm means reuse of that profile.

Operating-system caches were not flushed;
these

are not verified whole-machine cold and
warm boots.

With one sequential run per condition,
their small difference

is descriptive evidence, not a proven
acceleration.

This is an archived still from the
retained
cold control, not a new demonstration.

It shows the original login interface with
empty credential fields.

The canvas capture is twelve eighty by
nine sixty;

the requested browser viewport was a
different size.

Automatic color detection identified a
visible scene,

and image review classified that scene as
login.
Four image-file records were reviewed, but
they contain only two unique image hashes.
They are not four independent scenes.
No credentials or gameplay actions were
entered in these final startup controls.

After login, the cold observation records
one thousand seventy-three

frame advances over thirty-one point zero
nine four seconds.

The warm observation records one thousand
eighty

over thirty-one point one zero nine
seconds.

These are counter advances, not verified
display refreshes,

input responsiveness, or complete
simulation progress.

The original-input audit reports three
hundred

twenty-one matching entries before and
after the runs.

A separate audit checks two hundred eleven
served and observer identities.

Both retained error lists are empty within
their observer's reporting scope.

Hash matches establish scoped file
identity, not semantic correctness, and

thirty-one seconds of progress cannot
establish long-duration reliability.

The allocator is the component that
manages memory allocation and release.

The candidate replaced defensive
duplicate-free list scans

with an atomic ownership claim in an
allocation header.

That addresses a reproduced scaling cost;
it does

not prove duplicate frees caused a game
failure.
The microbenchmark repeatedly freed and

reallocated a five hundred twelve-byte
payload.

It used twenty thousand warmup pairs, then
five repetitions

of one hundred thousand pairs, across four
fresh

processes ordered control, candidate,
candidate, control.

Each reported value averages two process
medians.

This is a constructed workload with a
precisely defined comparison.

At retained-list depths of sixty-four
through five hundred

twelve, the candidate is approximately
five point one

to five point five times faster in this
microbenchmark.

At depth zero it is thirteen point nine
percent slower.

The benchmark includes JavaScript calls
and checks, tests one allocation

size, and does not measure concurrent
throughput or the game's allocation mix.

A separate short profile attributed only
two point five eight nine

percent of one active worker's sampled
wall intervals to heap freeing.

That window does not characterize complete
startup.
A local optimization can be real while its

whole-application benefit remains
unestablished.

The candidate's cold comparison was
interrupted

by a screenshot-helper stability timeout
at two

hundred ninety-seven point four eight four
seconds.

Its last sample still showed execution
without a runtime error.

We cannot label that an established
allocator failure.

A subsequent warm-profile launch reached
login at four hundred fifty-seven

point eight five nine seconds, but
followed interrupted cold priming.
It is not a matched warm comparison.

Later observer refinements were
incompletely validated,

and their proposed headed repair check did
not run.

The measured observer, prepared candidate,
and final

frozen source must remain separate
experimental objects.

The evidence supports an original-login
execution milestone.

It does not establish complete gameplay
compatibility, production

readiness, threefold acceleration, or
durable operation.

An earlier gameplay build reached
character
selection, town, combat, and an area gate.

Revival still failed, and two winning
cycles remained unaccepted.

Those observations retain their own build
identity.

One client, one final browser condition,
local native dependencies, and

a short observation cannot establish broad
Windows application support.

Beyond this game, the experiment raises
five research questions.

Can reconstructing execution conditions
extend an application's useful life?

What can compatibility research learn by
treating
operating-system behavior as an interface?

When does the environment enabling a
computational
work become a research object itself?

What must reproducibility preserve beyond
executable files?

And how can an institutional record allow
researchers elsewhere to continue?

These are implications and opportunities,
not

universal capabilities established by this
trial.

The environment, its interventions, and
the observations

deserve examination together with the
application.

The original experimental cycle has
closed.

This presentation does not reopen
engineering.

A future group could restore the artifacts
independently,

validate the final observer, repeat
startup and performance

studies, and test stated durations of
runtime stability.

A broader application corpus could probe
compatibility, while

archival work could reconstruct the
original execution conditions.

Each investigation needs its own scope and
evidence.

HEAV3NS does not promise to complete these
studies itself.
The record is published so others can

evaluate, cite, critique, and extend the
work.

Independent continuation requires matching
source snapshots,

dependency pins, local patches, generated
modules,

manifests, and the observer used for each
measurement.

It also requires the original client and
platform inputs, native

services, private configuration, and
appropriate database state.

The documentation archive excludes
credentials, database

contents, large binaries, and much raw
evidence.

The compatibility source license does not
grant

rights to distribute the game or platform
components.

Researchers need lawful access and any
necessary permissions, a

separate restoration workspace, and
authorization for a new experiment.

Hash verification is a starting point;
independent

clean-machine restoration has not been
demonstrated.
Audience: Is this just an emulator?
Dr. GPT: It includes x86 interpretation.

But the experiment also reconstructs
loading, selected Windows

contracts, browser adapters, resource
access, and service communication.

Calling it an emulator describes part of
the arrangement;

it does not establish its compatibility
coverage.

Audience: Did you rewrite the original
game?

Dr. GPT: There was no conventional
game-source rewrite as a web application.

Original compiled logic executes through
the compatibility runtime.

However, the documented send wrapper
modifies mapped

code, and loader fixups modify the
execution image.

Preserving audited disk files does not
erase those interventions.

Audience: Why does startup take seven
minutes?

Dr. GPT: The record does not establish a
complete causal explanation.
Original execution, compatibility work,

scheduling, and loading are possible
contributors.

A short one-worker profile identifies
dispatch and

allocator work, but cannot apportion the
entire startup.

Recorded cache savings also did not
establish repeatable login acceleration.

Better matched whole-application
measurements are needed.

Audience: Does this prove Windows games
can run in browsers?

Dr. GPT: It demonstrates this inherited
client's

login milestone under the retained
conditions.

It does not establish complete support
even for this

game, or general support for other Windows
games.
Broader compatibility requires additional

applications and explicit acceptance
criteria.

Audience: What is actually novel about the
experiment?

Dr. GPT: Its contribution is this specific
integration and its auditable

account: inherited client execution,
browser compatibility conditions,

native-service boundaries, interventions,
and bounded measurements.
The paper does not establish first-ever

priority or superiority over other
systems.

Much of its foundation is inherited and
explicitly credited.

Audience: Can another research group
reproduce your result?
Dr. GPT: The records provide a conditional

route, not a completed independent
replication.

A group needs the matching artifacts,
original and

private inputs, permissions, and a
validated observer.
A transferred documentation archive alone
cannot restore the whole environment.
Audience: What would need to happen before

this becomes a reliable compatibility
runtime?

Dr. GPT: Validate the observer and
restored artifacts, resolve open

loading, memory, networking, input, and
rendering contracts, and demonstrate

repeated startup, full gameplay gates, and
stated-duration stability.

Reliability must be measured against
declared conditions.

The present evidence does not supply that
acceptance.

Audience: Why publish this if the product
objective was not fully achieved?

Dr. GPT: A bounded result can still inform
research.

The execution milestone, local
optimization, failed comparison,

and unresolved contracts give others
something concrete to examine.

Publication makes those limits
inspectable; it does not

turn incomplete acceptance into a
completed product.

Our primary source is the BROCWIN
Technical White Paper, version

one point zero point one, dated October
eleventh, twenty twenty-six.

HEAV3NS commissioned and preserves the
record.

Credit remains with the original
developers, CardSorting and prior

local contributors, Wine-Assembly's human
and agent contributors,

Microsoft platform contributors, the
websockets contributors,

and recorded Codex integration and review
contributors.

The source slate identifies their
documented roles.

This recording uses synthesized presenter
and audience voices.

The questions are simulated; the archived
images

and measurements come from retained
evidence.

The significance of BROCWIN is not simply
whether
a particular MMO can run inside a browser.

The research investigates the
computational conditions that allow

inherited software to execute outside its
original environment.

Its results are bounded, its limitations
documented,

and its future open to independent
inquiry.

The originating institution has completed
this experimental cycle.
Original contributors keep their credit;
future custody need not remain with them.
The research can now propagate.
THE WORK NO LONGER DEMANDS AN AUTHOR.
